title: Ridgeline Orders & Delivery Delivery and Service Charge Schedule
content:
Every Ridgeline Orders & Delivery order carries the delivery or shipping charge of its fulfillment program, fixed per order in US dollars. Where a program sets a free-delivery threshold, the delivery charge is waived when the order's merchandise total is at or above that threshold; a threshold of $0.00 means the program has no such threshold. Haul-away of the customer's old item is offered with delivery only by a program marked as offering it, and the haul-away and basic install charges are the program's own figures below.

## Schedule by fulfillment program

| Fulfillment program | Delivery or shipping charge, per order | Free-delivery threshold (merchandise total) | Haul-away offered | Haul-away charge | Basic install charge | Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards delivery fee discount applies |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Ship to Home | $8.99 | $45.00 | No | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Buy Online Pick Up In Store | $0.00 | $0.00 (no threshold) | No | $0.00 | $0.00 | No |
| Ridgeline Ship to Store | $0.00 | $0.00 (no threshold) | No | $0.00 | $0.00 | No |
| Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | $39.00 | $0.00 (no threshold) | No | $0.00 | $0.00 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | $79.00 | $1500.00 | Yes | $49.00 | $0.00 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away | $29.00 | $396.00 | Yes | $0.00 | $99.00 | Yes |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Delivery or shipping charge.** The charge billed for delivering or shipping one order under the program.
2. **Free-delivery threshold.** The merchandise total at or above which the delivery charge is waived. A figure of $0.00 means no threshold, so no merchandise total waives the charge on that basis.
3. **Haul-away.** Removal of the customer's old item with delivery. It is offered only where the schedule shows "Yes"; the haul-away charge column states its price, which is $0.00 under Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away.
4. **Basic install.** The charge for basic hookup of a delivered appliance. A figure of $0.00 means basic install is not offered under the program or is included.
5. **Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards delivery fee discount.** "Yes" means the delivery fee discount of a Ridgeline ProBuild Rewards membership applies to the program's delivery charge; "No" means it does not apply to that program.

## Reading the threshold column (worked figures from this schedule)

| Program | Merchandise total | Threshold reached? | Delivery charge waived on the threshold? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgeline Ship to Home | $44.99 | No, below $45.00 | No |
| Ridgeline Ship to Home | $45.00 | Yes, equal to $45.00 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | $1499.99 | No, below $1500.00 | No |
| Ridgeline Scheduled Truck Delivery | $1500.00 | Yes, equal to $1500.00 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Appliance Delivery and Haul-Away | $396.00 | Yes, equal to $396.00 | Yes |
| Ridgeline Same-Day Delivery | any amount | No threshold set | No |

The merchandise totals in this table are illustrative inputs only; the charges and thresholds are the schedule's own figures.
